questions.stem: What happens to the rate of an enzyme-controlled reaction when substrate concentration is increased beyond a certain point?

options.text: The rate continues to increase indefinitely
The rate levels off because all active sites are occupied
The rate decreases because excess substrate inhibits the enzyme

questions.explanation: At high substrate concentrations, the rate levels off because all the enzyme active sites are saturated (occupied by substrate). Adding more substrate has no further effect until more enzyme is available.
